comment: Doing the textbook reading is helpful for the exams and honestly the only way to prepare for them. She is reasonable and the exams are pretty predictable based on the content.

Dr. Bowie is the best! This class is definitely a lot of work, but Dr. Bowie makes it interesting and rewarding. I always knew where I stood in the class. She was clear about expectations and I always knew what to expect going to class. I would definitely take another one of her classes!

Dr. Bowie is an amazing person and professor, you can tell she is very well-qualified and very passionate.
Lectures every day (not terribly boring), expects participation, daily homework (sizable readings), assignments are all papers (w/ very clear rubrics), course book is a great read
*if you're not interested in Courts & Amendments, do not take!
Dr. Bowie is great and gives good feedback. One thing is you can tell if she doesn't like you.

Dr. Bowie is nice and knows her stuff. Class can get a little repetitive, you just go through the cases you read as homework in a guided discussion kind of. A lot of writing assignments with no clear grading standards. She will give you whatever grade she wants so be sure to participate and meet with her to be on her good side and get a good grade.

Prof. Bowie is amazing! She's very personable and has fun with her class even when we're working through difficult content. She goes out of her way to make more 'boring' things like exams fun by using Harry Potter or Scooby Doo in her hypothetical cases and overall is just a great professor. Nothing is boring in her class!
